subject: monomer

descriptions.text: Isoprene is a hemiterpene with the formula CH2=C(CH3)CH=CH2; the monomer of natural rubber and a common structure motif to the isoprenoids, a large class of other naturally occurring compounds. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a volatile organic compound, an alkadiene and a hemiterpene.
Isoprene can cause cancer according to The World Health Organization's International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC).

uses: Used as a monomer to manufacture polyisoprene and butyl rubber; [HSDB]

Almost all isoprene produced is used for the preparation of polymers or copolymers. cis-Polyisoprene is the largest application with SIS block polymers a secondary application, and butyl rubber is a significant third application.
Smaller amounts are used as an intermediate into specialty chemicals, including vitamins, pharmaceuticals, flavorings, and perfumes, and epoxy hardeners.
Manufacture of "synthetic" natural rubber, butyl rubber. Copolymer in the production of synthetic elastomers.
In the raw state, rubber has limited application other than being dissolved in solvent for use as adhesives and solutions.

id.title: Karet
id.extract:
Karet, juga disebut karet India, lateks, karet Amazon, caucho, atau caoutchouc, dalam bentuk awalnya, terdiri atas polimer senyawa organik isoprena, dengan sejumlah kecil pengotor dari senyawa organik lainnya.
Jenis poliisoprena yang digunakan sebagai karet alam diklasifikasikan sebagai elastomer. Saat ini, karet terutama diperoleh dalam bentuk lateks dari pohon karet Pará (Hevea brasiliensis) atau spesies lainnya. Lateks merupakan koloid berwarna putih seperti susu dan lengket yang dikeluarkan dengan membuat sayatan pada kulit kayu dan mengumpulkan cairannya ke dalam wadah melalui proses yang disebut "penyadapan". Produsen memurnikan lateks ini menjadi karet yang siap diproses secara komersial.
Karet alam digunakan secara luas dalam berbagai aplikasi dan produk, baik sendiri maupun dikombinasikan dengan bahan lain. Dalam sebagian besar bentuk yang berguna, karet memiliki rasio regangan yang besar dan resilien tinggi, serta bersifat mengapung dan kedap air. Permintaan industri terhadap bahan mirip karet mulai melampaui pasokan karet alam pada akhir abad ke-19, sehingga menghasilkan sintesis karet sintetis melalui metode kimia pada 1909. Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, dan Kamboja merupakan empat negara produsen karet terkemuka.

en.title: Natural rubber
en.extract:
Rubber, also called India rubber, latex, Amazonian rubber, caucho, or caoutchouc, as initially produced, consists of polymers of the organic compound isoprene, with minor impurities of other organic compounds.
Types of polyisoprene that are used as natural rubbers are classified as elastomers. Currently, rubber is harvested mainly in the form of the latex from the Pará rubber tree (Hevea brasiliensis) or others. The latex is a sticky, milky and white colloid drawn off by making incisions in the bark and collecting the fluid in vessels in a process called "tapping". Manufacturers refine this latex into the rubber that is ready for commercial processing.
Natural rubber is used extensively in many applications and products, either alone or in combination with other materials. In most of its useful forms, it has a large stretch ratio and high resilience and also is buoyant and water-proof. Industrial demand for rubber-like materials began to outstrip natural rubber supplies by the end of the 19th century, leading to the synthesis of synthetic rubber in 1909 by chemical means. Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Cambodia are four of the leading rubber producers.
